headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: The management guided that Q2 experienced seasonal softness in the domestic market due to the monsoon period stalling cable-laying activities, but a strong demand rebound is anticipated in H2 driven by infrastructure spending.

Upgrade the stock to BUY with a TP of Rs307, assigning 10x PER on FY28E.  Higher realisation aided net sales: Ddev Plastiks reported net sales of Rs9.78Bn, registering a strong growth of 44% on basis, primarily driven by robust traction in the wires and cables segment and improved average realizations.

EBITDA for the quarter stood at Rs799Mn, implying a 25% year-on-year growth, while the EBITDA margin compressed to 8.2% primarily due to an inflationary raw material environment and elevated export freight costs.

The company delivered a consolidated net profit of Rs520Mn in Q2FY27, a growth of 10% YoY.  Sustainable earnings growth on card: We like the company given the pedigree of the management, a niche polymer player catering to diversified industries, robust 200+SKU base, long term association with the clients and debt-free balance sheet.
